newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda plans output on extra days in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Mazda plans output on extra days in Dec.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said on Tuesday that it would run the number one line of its plant at Ujina in western Japan for four extra days in December to keep up with domestic demand for its Demio compact recreational vehicle.
Mazda, owned 33.4 percent by Ford Motor Co, has sold 22,012 Demios since the model was launched on August 26 with a monthly sales target of 4,000 units.
Mazda has been exporting the Demio since late October to Australia, New Zealand and Hong Kong at a monthly rate of 500 units.

The Demio was named "The Best New Car of The Year" by the Automotive Researchers and Journalists Conference of Japan last month. It was chosen from 29 new models introduced by Japanese carmakers in the domestic market between November 1995 and October 1996.
